text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired PD-INC-4789 — p99 latency > 2.5s (30m window) on production routes (us-west / eu-west). Auto-escalation threshold met.
oncall_alex: Acked. I'm on it.
sre_jamie: Looking at traces — spike originates at batcher -> kv-cache eviction churn, lots of long tail tokenization requests. Seeing concurrent small hotkeys.
eng_maria: Any recent model or rollout changes?
prod_luke: No model rollouts in the last 4h. We did push a vectorizer tweak ~3h ago but it shouldn't affect generation path. Checking deploys now.
support_zoe: Tickets: 2 customers reported slow responses ~10m ago, both low-priority but noticing slow autocomplete. Adding to incident notes.
infra_rohit: Autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts 10m ago but failed due to region quota bump limit. GPU utilization ~92% on primary pool.
oncall_alex: Ok — plan: 1) apply routing fallback to smaller-model-2 for noisy routes (10% traffic), 2) trigger manual warm nodes in eu-west, 3) suppress noisy auto-paging for 15m while we validate. Agree? :thumbsup:
sre_jamie: Agree. Start small-model-2 rollout at 10% and watch p99. If KV eviction continues we'll throttle long requests.
eng_maria: I can flip the route. Command: ```
# route fallback to small-model-2 for route "chat.stream"
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/redwood/routes/fallback \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"chat.stream","fallback_model":"small-model-2","traffic_percent":10}'
```
prod_luke: I'll stand by to rollback if quality complaints spike. Notify product channels.
infra_rohit: Spun up 4 warm nodes in eu-west manually. Confirmed they passed healthchecks.
oncall_alex: Done the routing change (maria) and suppressed duplicate PagerDuty noise for 15m. Monitoring dashboards.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: alert PD-INC-4789 acknowledged by oncall_alex at 3109876551. Suppression window active.
sre_jamie: After 2m, p99 dropped from 2.8s -> 1.4s on routes shifted to fallback. Overall p99 down to 1.6s. KV eviction rate reduced.
support_zoe: Drafting a short customer bulletin about degraded latency and mitigation; will share for review.
eng_maria: Reverting vectorizer tweak to be safe? It was rolled 3h ago — but since traces point to cache churn maybe not necessary. Thoughts?
prod_luke: Let's hold on reverting for now. If we see quality regressions from fallback we can reassess.
infra_rohit: I'll request temporary quota bump for eu-west to allow autoscaler to expand more nodes; ETA ~25m.
oncall_alex: Good. I'll open a follow-up task to analyze hotkeys and long prompts. Handing over a concise summary to night oncall in 30m.
sre_jamie: Logging root cause candidate: sudden increase in long-token requests + KV eviction cascade + quota-limited autoscaler. Further RCA later.
support_zoe: Customer bulletin ready; posted to #customer-status-draft for review.
oncall_alex: Marking incident as mitigated. Keeping thread open for 1h for regression watch. If stable, I'll close. Thanks everyone. :tada:
incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-4789 mitigation acknowledged by oncall_alex at 3109876777 — status: mitigated (monitoring). Autoclose scheduled in 60m if no regression.
